We intend to submit a BLA under the accelerated approval pathway pending results of a prespecified interim analysis from the DECLARATION pivotal study planned in the fourth quarter of 2026.

The DECLARATION interim analysis is designed to evaluate serum virus neutralizing antibody titers, pharmacokinetics, immunogenicity, and safety of VYD2311, while keeping blinded the clinical events collected to date.
If the interim analysis results are positive, we intend to submit a BLA seeking accelerated approval based on DECLARATION, supported by data from LIBERTY and Invivyd’s broader COVID-19 mAb program.
